integration_issues.issue: Iteration 32 item still open: syncNow sets lastSyncedAt / 'Just now' even when result.errors is not empty. Reference: /app/frontend/contexts/HeraContext.tsx:341-344

issues: The demo account shows 'Beautiful Soul' on Home and an empty Name field in Edit Profile, but the backend users doc has name 'Demo'. The name is not filled in after a password login. Edit Profile save then fails with 'Name Required' until a name is typed.

react_native_issues.issue: The recovery check uses getStatusAsync().isPlaying, which maps to player.playing. On native, playing is false while a remote stream is still buffering. A tap on 'Mute' in the first seconds (slow network) then stops and recreates the player instead of muting it, and repeated taps keep restarting the download. Suggest recreating only on a real error or when not loaded (e.g. track an error flag through a playbackStatusUpdate listener, or check isLoaded/isBuffering). Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:734-735, /app/frontend/src/utils/av-shim.ts:22-24

critical_code_review_comments: useRequireOnline moved to its own file, so the import cycle with api.ts is gone; network.ts is clean. The native 2s debounce on isInternetReachable=false looks correct and is cleared on every change.
Vision detail handleDelete, chat handleClearChat, profile sync button, edit-profile save, the home favorite and handleSubmit all call requireOnline() before any confirm or navigation, as requested.
In Edit Profile the name check runs before requireOnline(), so offline users see 'Name Required' first if the name is empty. This is acceptable.
